list: SELECT i.source,i.schedule_id,i.revision,i.metadata_json,s.revision AS state_revision,s.definition_revision AS scheduled_revision,s.next_run_at FROM acp_plan_index i LEFT JOIN acp_plan_state s ON s.source=i.source AND s.schedule_id=i.schedule_id WHERE i.source=? AND i.schedule_id>? ORDER BY i.schedule_id LIMIT ?
due: SELECT i.source,i.schedule_id,i.revision,i.metadata_json,s.revision AS state_revision,s.definition_revision AS scheduled_revision,s.next_run_at FROM acp_plan_state s JOIN acp_plan_index i ON i.source=s.source AND i.schedule_id=s.schedule_id WHERE s.source=? AND s.next_run_at<=? AND (? IS NULL OR s.next_run_at>? OR (s.next_run_at=? AND s.schedule_id>?)) AND i.enabled=1 AND s.definition_revision=i.revision AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_plan_runs r WHERE r.source=s.source AND r.schedule_id=s.schedule_id AND r.status IN ('claimed','unknown')) ORDER BY s.next_run_at,s.schedule_id LIMIT ?
